claims: C1 OpenAI's Usage Policies prohibit many potential harmful usages of the services, such as spamming and scamming
C2 some of these prohibited usages are not specifically addressed by the Model Spec
C3 these violations are difficult to address at the level of model behavior because they concern how content is used after it is generated
C4 these violations are primarily addressed at a system level

concepts.name: usage_policies
concepts.gloss: P is OpenAI's Usage Policies document

concepts.name: prohibited_harmful_usage
concepts.gloss: U is a usage of OpenAI's services that the Usage Policies prohibit as potentially harmful

concepts.name: not_specifically_addressed_by_model_spec
concepts.gloss: U is a usage of the services that the Model Spec does not specifically address

concepts.name: difficult_to_address_at_model_behavior_level
concepts.gloss: V is a violation of the Usage Policies that is difficult to address at the level of model behavior

concepts.name: primarily_addressed_at_system_level
concepts.gloss: V is a violation that is primarily addressed at a system level rather than at the level of model behavior

concepts.name: usage_of_services
concepts.gloss: usage U is a usage of the services governed by the Usage Policies document P
